description: This file contains utility functions and enums for handling markdown syntax within an Android app, specifically for editing and rendering markdown content.

classes.name: MarkdownSpan
classes.description: Enum class representing various markdown syntax spans such as bold, italics, headings, etc.

methods.name: insertMarkdown
methods.description: Inserts or toggles markdown syntax around the selected text or current line, depending on the span.

methods.name: toggleCheckmarkCurrentLine
methods.description: Toggles a checkbox marker in the current line, turning empty brackets into checked brackets and vice versa.

methods.name: hyperlinkMarkdown
methods.description: Creates a markdown hyperlink string given a URL and display content.

methods.name: imageMarkdown
methods.description: Creates a markdown image string given an image URL and description.

methods.name: tableMarkdown
methods.description: Generates a markdown table skeleton with specified number of rows and columns.
